cost_status: 18.77 km is a derived along-line distance proxy from official adjacent fare distances, for one Songshan-Xindian service. Compare one service only vs one service plus an assumed full-length empty return (37.54 km). scope: Select among 0-8 extra-train heuristic plans; preserve baseline departures. No terminal dispatch readiness, full-line conflicts, fleet or crew constraints; no online feedback control.
